title: Data Stories
subtitle: Visualizations and narratives from public datasets
author: Sunil Dhaka

stories.title: Bijli: How India Keeps the Lights On
stories.description: From a 765 kV tower on the Deccan to the sodium lamp on your colony's gate -- a first-principles engineering tour of the third-largest power system on Earth. 505 GW of capacity, 28 states, and one 50 Hz heartbeat that must be balanced every second of every day.

stories.title: The Field and the Ledger: An Economic History of India, Told Through Its Farms
stories.description: In 1700 India produced a quarter of the world's output; by 1950, four percent. Five centuries of the field and the ledger -- Mughal zabt, the Company's drain, famines, the Green and White Revolutions, and the scissors that never closed: 46% of workers, 16% of GDP.

stories.title: From Horses to Satellites: A Century of American Farming
stories.description: In 1900, four in ten Americans lived on a farm; today fewer than two in a hundred do -- yet the land grows six times the corn. A photographic almanac of how machines, techniques, and ownership remade US agriculture from 1900 to today, written for readers who have never seen it.

stories.title: Who Runs India? The Executive Government Directory
stories.description: The complete directory of India's executive government -- 31 Cabinet Ministers, 41 Ministers of State, 90+ Secretaries, and 150+ Joint Secretaries across all 54 ministries. Searchable, filterable, with bios and IAS batch details.

stories.title: The Rupee Tax: 64 Years of Purchasing Power Destruction
stories.description: Prices multiplied 90x since 1960. But inflation is radically non-uniform -- gold inflated 47x, cars only 3x, and telecom deflated to zero. The average inflation number is a fiction.

stories.title: India's Petroleum Appetite: 239 Million Tonnes and Climbing
stories.description: The world's third-largest oil consumer uses 1/22nd the oil per person that America does. Kerosene has collapsed 93%, India has overtaken China as the #1 source of oil demand growth, and 88% of crude is imported.

stories.title: India's Urban Growth Ponzi Scheme
stories.description: India is importing America's failed suburban development model while abandoning its own traditional cities -- which already embody everything the world's best urbanists now advocate.

stories.title: The Guar Story: Rajasthan's Desert Gold
stories.description: How a drought-resistant bean from the Thar Desert connects Rajasthan's farmers to America's oil rigs -- a $2.5B commodity that's cheapest where it's grown.
